svg.title: Expenses · Healthcare, childcare, charity wireframe
svg.text: Typed expenses that carry tax meaning.
Subtype drives the tax fields. One row per typed expense.
Medicare starts Jan 2055 at $2,900, then rises with healthcare inflation
Typed expenses keep the subtype and its tax fields. Medicare is $0 before 2055 and $2,900 in 2055, rising with
The preview line comes from the backend run, so it matches the projection. No client-side inflation math.
Childcare ends automatically at the set end date (5 years in the example), and the row stops contributing.
Charitable treatment follows the chosen form: cash, securities, QCD, or DAF. ACA reconciliation ships in #48.
